description:
**NASA Space 2026 🚀 – Galaxy Riders 🌌**

Galaxy Riders is a brave team that explores space, planets, and stars. We work together, learn new things, and complete exciting space missions.

In NASA Space 2026, we design space games, explore the planet and stars , and experience jumping in space. We use our creativity, teamwork, and skills to discover the wonders of the universe! 🌟
summary: Our app ,Galaxy Riders is to teach students more about space while having fun. There is a lot of fun mechanism for secondary students to explore .our game has a lot of benefits ,students can learn about space while having fun ,this makes their learning session fun and beneficial .At first ,we tried using Chat GPT to help us in coding the app . However , it didn't work as well as intended .So instead of continue using Chat GPT , we tried using Google AI Studio ,an AI app that is built specifically to help learning students like us create apps with the help of modern technology .In the end ,it worked out surprisingly well .In conclusion, we went through some trial and error ,but in the end we successfully created our app------Galaxy Riders
details: Our app, Galaxy Riders helps students learn more about space in an interesting and fast way, not only does it benefit the student in learning, but it is also a very fun app to play. Galaxy Riders is intended to help students learn about space while having fun. This way they can learn in a stress free way. Our group used Google AI studio to help use with the coding and develop our project. Galaxy Riders is creative because we make space learning fun with games that teach you a lot about the planets characteristics, another point is that we made this game without any preferences from social media or any website. We decided to create this app to help students in their road of learning about space ,we thought about the creativity and how to attract more students to learn about space while having fun.
